question: Does a hard bank of same-capacity per-scene explicit operators have evaluator-Oracle value beyond family-global and train-selected medoid controls?

case_operator.family: three-segment endpoint-fixed monotone curves then positive row-stochastic matrix

controls.family_global: fit the same operator on all outer-train scenes
controls.train_medoid: case with minimum mean error on other outer-train scenes; no held target access
controls.fixed_first_case: lexicographically first train case negative control
controls.oracle: post-hoc minimum held-target RMSE over train cases; evaluator only

branches.oracle_pass: freeze the case bank representation and preregister source-only content retrieval with hard Top-1, medoid fallback and no confirmation access
branches.oracle_fail: close case routing on this source without retriever or larger case operator
branches.retrieval_later_fails: retain family-global/basic research controls and close routing

forbidden: use held target pixels to choose a deployable case
increase per-case capacity or tune gates after execution
claim a case is exposure, stock, process or scanner truth
claim_ceiling: development-only evaluator-Oracle for one-author weak-paired camera/film display-chain cases; not a selector, stock mode, calibration, product or commercial-use training
